source.coverage: Dutch VOC and predecessors Europe–Asia round trips, not complete intra-Asian routes, ports outside WPI51 not a route-negative

exclusions.Bali: island not among source-verified WPI 51 indexed landmass nodes
exclusions.Amboina: Moluccas island outside WPI source panel
exclusions.Ternate: Moluccas island outside WPI source panel
exclusions.Tidore: Moluccas island outside WPI source panel
exclusions.China: vague region, no unique geographic destination
exclusions.Bengal: vague region, not a specific island

primary_metric: voyages with one Dutch metropolitan source port endpoint and one specific historic Asian/island port assigned to an original WPI51 island node, 1595–1795
secondary: also include coarse island-labelled endpoints, but preserve counts separately
other_voyage_endpoint_pairs: map only when BOTH source endpoints independently map to eligible WPI51 island nodes; if no such journeys source-covered not equal to no trade
links_not_negatives: unrecorded voyage edges from this selected transoceanic VOC archive are UNKNOWN, not absence of all colonial shipping
scientific_inference_ceiling: These are 16th-18th century Dutch Europe–Asia journey endpoints; Cape of Good Hope stopover cannot be ignored or relabeled a direct transshipment
Historical port alias matches to physical islands do NOT establish that modern WPI 2019 harbors operated then
These routes do NOT establish recorded host plant cargo, naturalization chronology or butterfly colonization in 2001–2024
Use source-verified port-city aliases only for primary direct harbor coverage; broad Ceylon/Madagascar/Mauritius aliases are alternate
Source archival sampling is Dutch VOC, not comprehensive colonial shipping of GB/ESP/PRT/NL or France and other empires
